players.bio: Arkell Nicholas Cecil Jude-Boyd (born 22 January 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town. Born in England, he plays for the Saint Lucia national team.
Cameron Gregory (born 20 January 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town.

Gavin Cowan (born 24 May 1981) is an English football manager and former player who is the head coach of EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town. He has notably played as a professional in the Football League for Shrewsbury Town. He has also played for Braintree Town, Canvey Island, Nuneaton Borough, Kidderminster Harriers, Grays Athletic, AFC Telford United, Fleetwood Town and Gainsborough Trinity.

George Robert Lawrence Lloyd (born 11 February 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town. He made his first-team debut at Cheltenham Town during the 2017–18 season and spent much of the following campaign on loan at Hereford.
Isaac Andrew Fletcher (born 1 June 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town .
Isaac Lee, also known as Lee Isaac, (born 3 September 2003) is a South Korean professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town.

Jack Alexander Price, (born 19 December 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder. Price progressed from the academy of Wolverhampton Wanderers to sign a professional contract in 2011. The midfielder made his senior debut on 10 August 2013. On 8 January 2018, Price joined Major League Soccer side Colorado Rapids.
Jay Turner-Cooke (born 31 December 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town.
Joe Gbodé (Joseph Paul Caleb Gbodé) is a 21-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Shrewsbury Town F.C., on loan from EFL League One club Luton Town F.C..
Josh Davison is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Shrewsbury Town.

Joshua Andrew Bernard Ruffels (born 23 October 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back. Early life Ruffels was born in Oxford, Oxfordshire. Career Coventry City Ruffels made his first-team debut for Coventry City as a substitute on 16 August 2011 in a 2–1 defeat to Crystal Palace in the Championship, coming on to replace injured Gary McSheffrey after 18 minutes.

Kevin Nana Yaw Berkoe (born 5 July 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Shrewsbury Town. Berkoe began his career in the youth academies of Chelsea and Wolverhampton Wanderers, before making his professional debut for Oxford United in 2019.

Lino Gonçalo da Cruz Sousa (born 19 January 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL League One club Rotherham United, on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa. Born in Portugal, he is a youth international for England.
Luca Anthony Hoole (born 2 June 2002) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a full-back or centre-back for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town.
Michael Heinz Golding is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town, on loan from EFL League One club Leicester City.

Sam Proctor is a 19-year-old goalkeeper currently playing for Shrewsbury Town on a season-long loan from Premier League club Aston Villa. He is an England youth international, having represented his country from the Under-16 to the Under-20 levels.
Samuel Alan Stubbs (born 20 November 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two side Shrewsbury Town.

Thomas Roy Sang (born 29 June 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town. A versatile defensive midfielder, he can also play at right-back. His father, Neil, played professional football. Sang began his career in the youth team at Bolton Wanderers before joining Manchester United following a successful trial in 2019.

Will Gray is a 17-year-old professional English footballer who plays as a midfielder for Shrewsbury Town F.C. in EFL League Two. Born on 19 April 2009, Gray is a product of the Shrewsbury youth academy, having originally joined the club at just six years old.

William Sam Douglas Harry Boyle (born 1 September 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre back for EFL League Two club Shrewsbury Town. Boyle was born in Garforth, West Yorkshire. He attended Garforth Community College before joining Huddersfield Town's academy at under-15 level from his local club Garforth Villa in October 2010.
William Michael Brook (born 9 November 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Shrewsbury Town in EFL League Two.
